title: Lane
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of max-rep hang power snatches at three-quarters bodyweight and max-rep handstand push-ups, resting as needed between rounds. A 2021 Girl in the Lynne format: not for time, score is total reps. Scale the bar or use pike push-ups.
